BiblicalUsage: Perazah is open country, unwalled villages. The Jews of the villages kept the fourteenth day of Adar with gladness, and Gog says he will go up to the land of unwalled villages, to those who dwell safely without walls or gates.
TheologicalSignificance: I am sure that unwalled villages are safe only when God is their wall: the Jews feasted without fear, and Gog will find no wall to break.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
